name: explore
description: Return the background metadata cache for the active dashboard's worksheets (summary columns + visual specs). Reads whatever is already loaded — instant, no extra API calls.

name: overview-state-ranking
description: Superstore Overview: VISIBLY clicks through a showcase of states on the Sale Map (KPI cards / charts narrow each time) and ranks every state/province by Profit Ratio and by Sales, with the company headline KPIs.

name: product-peak-months
description: Superstore Product: for each Region, the peak and trough sales month per product category (Furniture / Office Supplies / Technology).

name: customers-top3
description: Superstore Customers: VISIBLY filters Category + Segment for a showcase of combos (the dashboard narrows each time) and returns the top 3 customers by sales for every Category x Segment combination, with profit and profit ratio.

name: shipping-delays
description: Superstore Shipping: for each Ship Mode, the order line with the greatest shipping delay (Days to Ship Actual) across the full date history.

name: performance-outliers
description: Superstore Performance: for each year, the category with the biggest overshoot and biggest shortfall vs sales target, plus the sharpest single month/segment/category outlier.

name: commission-plan
description: Superstore Commission Model: drives the Commission Rate and New Quota parameters live — OTE + top earner at 6/9/12%, and how many reps clear 100% of quota at $400k/$500k/$600k.

name: daily-executive-summary
description: Executive report across the six Superstore dashboards: drives every dashboard's filters, parameters, and mark selections VISIBLY, then assembles a single HTML summary.
